description: Defines the CheckToStringNode class used for sandbox safety checks when casting expressions to strings in Twig templates.

classes.name: Twig\Node\CheckToStringNode
classes.description: A node in Twig's abstract syntax tree that checks if casting an expression to a string is permitted by the sandbox security feature.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the node with the given expression to check.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to perform the sandbox check for toString casting.
